q: When 8 is added to the numerator of a fraction and 12 is added to its denominator, the fraction becomes 1/2. When 2 is subtracted from its numerator and denominator, the fraction becomes 1/8. Find the original fraction.
explain: Let the fraction be x/y. Condition 1: (x+8)/(y+12) = 1/2 => 2x - y = -4. Condition 2: (x-2)/(y-2) = 1/8 => 8x - y = 14. Solving these equations gives x = 3 and y = 10.
